title: Resource capacity
subtitle: Available capacity and initiative demand per resourcing role and month, in full-time equivalents (FTE).

grid.title: Capacity by role and month
grid.intro: Demand counts planned and committed demand of initiatives that are not cancelled or completed.
grid.caption: Capacity grid: available, demand and committed FTE per role and month
grid.noConflicts: No over-allocated cell among the months with known capacity.
grid.rule: A conflict means demand is above the available capacity; the shortfall is demand minus available. A month without a capacity row is Unknown, never treated as enough capacity.
grid.emptyBody: Capacity appears once resourcing roles and capacity are recorded.

demands.title: Resource demand
demands.intro: Initiative demand per role and month. Committing a demand records the capacity owner's commitment.
demands.caption: Resource demands
demands.releaseBody: The demand no longer counts against capacity.
demands.notApproval: Committing capacity is a resourcing commitment, not a business approval.
